external_entities.name: Suppliers
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.

external_entities.name: Category managers
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal, issues supplier credentials, and pushes the nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: The service loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where the uploaded compliance documents stay.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organization's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and staff contact details to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: compliance paperwork and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.description: The portal stores uploaded documents in the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." System description: "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These are conflicting positive claims about the extract's in-transit encryption, so encryption_in_transit remains unknown.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the nightly file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the vendor platform are confidential because it stores compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The store contains insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the landing bucket are confidential because it receives a supplier data extract containing supplier records and personal contact details.
assumptions.basis: The bucket receives the nightly supplier data extract, which is described as supplier data.

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the supplier database are confidential because it stores supplier records derived from the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The supplier master service writes the extracted supplier records into the database.
